title: the next gate read cannot be a measurement: 4 post-intervention post(s) inside the 09-28 13:00 review window (need 5) while the render loop is refused
evidence: next weekly review 09-28 13:00Z; its window is [(review - 7d), review]. Post-intervention pool (photos rendered at/after 2026-09-21 23:35:00Z -- the content-mix lever, inside Growth::GateRead::INTERVENTION_AT): 7. Inside that window: 0 already published + 4 queued = 4, against MIN_COHORT_POSTS=5. Below it Growth::GateRead returns :extend ("re-read, do NOT act") regardless of the date, so the pre-registered GO/PIVOT/KILL read is deferred by arithmetic, not by waiting. Render loop: 4 refusal(s) in the last 12h, so no new post-intervention photo can enter the pool -- the cohort is fed only by renders (publication lags them by the queue depth). That is why a GPU refusal starves the STRATEGY decision and not merely a render window. Not a Tim ask: the holder is another project's live job. Self-closes when the loop stops being refused.
